verses.en: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.
verses.pt: Jesus, levantando os olhos, viu os ricos deitarem as suas ofertas no cofre;
verses.en_web: He looked up, and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.
verses.en_bbe: And looking up, he saw the men of wealth putting their offerings in the money-box.

verses.en: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
verses.pt: viu também uma pobre viúva lançar ali dois leptos;
verses.en_web: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.
verses.en_bbe: And he saw a certain poor widow putting in a farthing.

verses.en: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:
verses.pt: e disse: Em verdade vos digo que esta pobre viúva deu mais do que todos;
verses.en_web: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Truly I say to you, This poor widow has given more than all of them:

verses.en: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.
verses.pt: porque todos aqueles deram daquilo que lhes sobrava; mas esta, da sua pobreza, deu tudo o que tinha para o seu sustento.
verses.en_web: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”
verses.en_bbe: For they gave out of their wealth, having more than enough for themselves: but she, even out of her need, has put in all her living.

verses.en: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,
verses.pt: E falando-lhe alguns a respeito do templo, como estava ornado de formosas pedras e dádivas, disse ele:
verses.en_web: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,
verses.en_bbe: And some were talking about the Temple, how it was made fair with beautiful stones and with offerings, but he said,

verses.en: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.pt: Quanto a isto que vedes, dias virão em que não se deixará aqui pedra sobre pedra, que não seja derribada.
verses.en_web: “As for these things which you see, the days will come, in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”
verses.en_bbe: As for these things which you see, the days will come when not one stone will be resting on another, but all will be broken down.

verses.en: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?
verses.pt: Perguntaram-lhe então: Mestre, quando, pois, sucederão estas coisas? E que sinal haverá, quando elas estiverem para se cumprir?
verses.en_web: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”
verses.en_bbe: And they said to him, Master, when will these things be? and what sign will there be when these events are to take place?

verses.en: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.
verses.pt: Respondeu então ele: Acautelai-vos; não sejais enganados; porque virão muitos em meu nome, dizendo: Sou eu; e: O tempo é chegado; não vades após eles.
verses.en_web: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Take care that you are not tricked: for a number of people will come in my name, saying, I am he; and, The time is near: do not go after them.

verses.en: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.
verses.pt: Quando ouvirdes de guerras e tumultos, não vos assusteis; pois é necessário que primeiro aconteçam essas coisas; mas o fim não será logo.
verses.en_web: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”
verses.en_bbe: And when news of wars and troubled times comes to your ears, have no fear; for these things have to be, but the end will not be now.

verses.en: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:
verses.pt: Então lhes disse: Levantar-se-á nação contra nação, e reino contra reino;
verses.en_web: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
verses.en_bbe: Then he said to them, Nation will be moved against nation and kingdom against kingdom:

verses.en: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.
verses.pt: e haverá em vários lugares grandes terremotos, e pestes e fomes; haverá também coisas espantosas, e grandes sinais do céu.
verses.en_web: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.
verses.en_bbe: There will be great earth-shocks and outbursts of disease in a number of places, and men will be without food; and there will be wonders and great signs from heaven.

verses.en: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name’s sake.
verses.pt: Mas antes de todas essas coisas vos hão de prender e perseguir, entregando-vos às sinagogas e aos cárceres, e conduzindo-vos à presença de reis e governadores, por causa do meu nome.
verses.en_web: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.
verses.en_bbe: But before all this, they will take you and be very cruel to you, giving you up to the Synagogues and to prisons, taking you before kings and rulers, because of my name.

verses.en: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
verses.pt: Isso vos acontecerá para que deis testemunho.
verses.en_web: It will turn out as a testimony for you.
verses.en_bbe: And it will be turned to a witness for you.

verses.en: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:
verses.pt: Proponde, pois, em vossos corações não premeditar como haveis de fazer a vossa defesa;
verses.en_web: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,
verses.en_bbe: So take care not to be troubled before the time comes, about what answers you will give:

verses.en: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.
verses.pt: porque eu vos darei boca e sabedoria, a que nenhum dos vossos adversário poderá resistir nem contradizer.
verses.en_web: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.
verses.en_bbe: For I will give you words and wisdom, so that not one of those who are against you will be able to get the better of you, or to put you in the wrong.

verses.en: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.
verses.pt: E até pelos pais, e irmãos, e parentes, e amigos sereis entregues; e matarão alguns de vós;
verses.en_web: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.
verses.en_bbe: But you will be given up even by your fathers and mothers, your brothers and relations and friends; and some of you will be put to death.

verses.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake.
verses.pt: e sereis odiados de todos por causa do meu nome.
verses.en_web: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.
verses.en_bbe: And you will be hated by all men, because of me.

verses.en: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.
verses.pt: Mas não se perderá um único cabelo da vossa cabeça.
verses.en_web: And not a hair of your head will perish.
verses.en_bbe: But not a hair of your head will come to destruction.

verses.en: In your patience possess ye your souls.
verses.pt: Pela vossa perseverança ganhareis as vossas almas.
verses.en_web: “By your endurance you will win your lives.
verses.en_bbe: By going through all these things, you will keep your lives.

verses.en: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.
verses.pt: Mas, quando virdes Jerusalém cercada de exércitos, sabei então que é chegada a sua desolação.
verses.en_web: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.
verses.en_bbe: But when you see armies all round about Jerusalem, then be certain that her destruction is near.

verses.en: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.
verses.pt: Então, os que estiverem na Judéia fujam para os montes; os que estiverem dentro da cidade, saiam; e os que estiverem nos campos não entrem nela.
verses.en_web: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.
verses.en_bbe: Then let those who are in Judaea go in flight to the mountains; and those who are in the middle of the town go out; and let not those who are in the country come in.

verses.en: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
verses.pt: Porque dias de vingança são estes, para que se cumpram todas as coisas que estão escritas.
verses.en_web: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
verses.en_bbe: For these are the days of punishment, in which all the things in the Writings will be put into effect.

verses.en: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.
verses.pt: Ai das que estiverem grávidas, e das que amamentarem naqueles dias! porque haverá grande angústia sobre a terra, e ira contra este povo.
verses.en_web: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land, and wrath to this people.
verses.en_bbe: It will be hard for women who are with child, and for her with a baby at the breast, in those days. For great trouble will come on the land, and wrath on this people.

verses.en: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
verses.pt: E cairão ao fio da espada, e para todas as nações serão levados cativos; e Jerusalém será pisada pelos gentios, até que os tempos destes se completem.
verses.en_web: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
verses.en_bbe: And they will be put to death with the sword, and will be taken as prisoners into all the nations; and Jerusalem will be crushed under the feet of the Gentiles, till the times of the Gentiles are complete.

verses.en: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;
verses.pt: E haverá sinais no sol, na lua e nas estrelas; e sobre a terra haverá angústia das nações em perplexidade pelo bramido do mar e das ondas.
verses.en_web: There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;
verses.en_bbe: And there will be signs in the sun and moon and stars; and on the earth, fear among the nations and doubt because of the loud noise of the sea and the waves;

verses.en: Men’s hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
verses.pt: os homens desfalecerão de terror, e pela expectação das coisas que sobrevirão ao mundo; porquanto os poderes do céu serão abalados.
verses.en_web: men fainting for fear, and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world: for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
verses.en_bbe: Men's strength will go from them in fear and in waiting for the things which are coming on the earth; for the powers of the heavens will be moved.

verses.en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
verses.pt: Então verão vir o Filho do homem em uma nuvem, com poder e grande glória.
verses.en_web: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
verses.en_bbe: And then they will see the Son of man coming in a cloud, with power and great glory.

verses.en: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.
verses.pt: Ora, quando essas coisas começarem a acontecer, exultai e levantai as vossas cabeças, porque a vossa redenção se aproxima.
verses.en_web: But when these things begin to happen, look up, and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”
verses.en_bbe: But when these things come about, let your heads be lifted up, because your salvation is near.

verses.en: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;
verses.pt: Propôs-lhes então uma parábola: Olhai para a figueira, e para todas as árvores;
verses.en_web: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree, and all the trees.
verses.en_bbe: And he made a story for them: See the fig-tree, and all the trees;

verses.en: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.
verses.pt: quando começam a brotar, sabeis por vós mesmos, ao vê-las, que já está próximo o verão.
verses.en_web: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.
verses.en_bbe: When they put out their young leaves, you take note of it, and it is clear to you that summer is coming.

verses.en: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.
verses.pt: Assim também vós, quando virdes acontecerem estas coisas, sabei que o reino de Deus está próximo.
verses.en_web: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.
verses.en_bbe: In the same way, when you see these things taking place you may be certain that the kingdom of God is near.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.
verses.pt: Em verdade vos digo que não passará esta geração até que tudo isso se cumpra.
verses.en_web: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.
verses.en_bbe: Truly I say to you, This generation will not come to an end till all things are complete.

verses.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.pt: Passará o céu e a terra, mas as minhas palavras jamais passarão.
verses.en_web: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.
verses.en_bbe: Heaven and earth will come to an end, but my words will not come to an end.

verses.en: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.
verses.pt: Olhai por vós mesmos; não aconteça que os vossos corações se carreguem de glutonaria, de embriaguez, e dos cuidados da vida, e aquele dia vos sobrevenha de improviso como um laço.
verses.en_web: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.
verses.en_bbe: But give attention to yourselves, for fear that your hearts become over-full of the pleasures of food and wine, and the cares of this life, and that day may come on you suddenly, and take you as in a net:

verses.en: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.
verses.pt: Porque há de vir sobre todos os que habitam na face da terra.
verses.en_web: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.
verses.en_bbe: For so it will come on all those who are living on the face of all the earth.

verses.en: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
verses.pt: Vigiai, pois, em todo o tempo, orando, para que possais escapar de todas estas coisas que hão de acontecer, e estar em pé na presença do Filho do homem.
verses.en_web: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”
verses.en_bbe: But keep watch at all times with prayer, that you may be strong enough to come through all these things and take your place before the Son of man.

verses.en: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.
verses.pt: Ora, de dia ensinava no templo, e à noite, saindo, pousava no monte chamado das Oliveiras.
verses.en_web: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.
verses.en_bbe: And every day he was teaching in the Temple and every night he went out to the mountain which is named the Mountain of Olives to take his rest.

verses.en: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.
verses.pt: E todo o povo ia ter com ele no templo, de manhã cedo, para o ouvir.
verses.en_web: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.
verses.en_bbe: And all the people came early in the morning to give ear to his words in the Temple.
